Pakistan Cricket Team Overhauls Squad Mid-Series

The Pakistan Cricket Board has made significant changes to its squad and coaching staff midway through a Test series against England. Seven players were sent home, and the roles of head coach Sarfaraz Ahmed and bowling coach Umar Gul were altered. Former Pakistan coach Jason Gillespie criticized these mid-series overhauls, describing them as a lack of stability and comparing the selectors' decision-making to changing their minds frequently. Aaqib Javed has been blamed by some for the selection chaos.
